## Summary / 摘要

Fixes the confirmed P2-OBS01 from PR #29 on top of the exact tested product SHA `0cd1278468d0471b862e16ca4ffcac41aead5e6d`.

- Excludes the V3 admin navigation action from the global trusted-click dirty heuristic. Opening the admin/backup area is navigation, not a business-data edit.
- Replaces the silent S4 download guard return with explicit user-visible status for unavailable, busy, blocked, or dirty states.
- Adds a regression step to the existing real-browser full-backup/restore acceptance test: click the top admin navigation action, reopen the backup area normally, then verify a real S4 ZIP download.

## Validation / 验证

- CI and browser tests have **not yet been run for this candidate**. Await the exact-HEAD GitHub Actions results.
- Independent Codex Cloud verification is required after CI succeeds.
- Keep PR #24 and PR #29 open pending review and independent validation.

## Safety boundary / 安全边界

No main changes, no merges, no real-user data. Existing S4 archive/restore logic is otherwise unchanged. This PR is Draft until CI and independent acceptance complete.

### 全部样本及失败保留

- 定向序列29次物理点击：**26次下载+3次安全阻止**；另有首次业务备份1份，全程30次S4点击、27个实际S4 ZIP均已解析校验。

对照F01/B01：**项目区展开时，左侧提示可见**，即使顶部indicator在视口上方；因此不是所有状态无提示，也不能只凭header越界判其他控制失败。[展开对照](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/blob/e289c79346d9417ae9acf3cc8eb1ee247e27b81c/docs/uat/20261020-pr30-obs01-fix-uat/evidence/SUP-F01-before-scroll.png) / [上滚后](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/blob/e289c79346d9417ae9acf3cc8eb1ee247e27b81c/docs/uat/20261020-pr30-obs01-fix-uat/evidence/SUP-F01-after-scroll.png)。

预期：阻止原因在备份按钮附近或可靠可见通知中出现，或主动揭示状态区。建议开发者处理这个条件性体验缺口后定向复验；**未自行修复**。原admin误置dirty故障本次没有重现；本P3不等于原根因仍在。

### CI及独立业务证据

开始门槛：[push run39362505327](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/actions/runs/39362505327)、[PR run39362512675](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/actions/runs/39362512675) Windows/Linux均success。是同一S3/S4工作流的两个触发，未冒称两套不同UI工作流。先本地完整执行Python43/Node10/Chromium43，全部通过，再自主GUI验收。

实际比较合计A/B原638/692，B修订后638/717，理论638、人工662；无报价不当0。A/B20任一不需要高价理由，B改21后复核恢复、选择C20清零，SQLite/刷新/真实重启/完整历史恢复保持。

[主trace](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/blob/e289c79346d9417ae9acf3cc8eb1ee247e27b81c/docs/uat/20261020-pr30-obs01-fix-uat/evidence/independent-v31-browser-trace.zip) · [控制trace](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/blob/e289c79346d9417ae9acf3cc8eb1ee247e27b81c/docs/uat/20261020-pr30-obs01-fix-uat/evidence/feedback-control-trace.zip) · [主浏览器](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/blob/e289c79346d9417ae9acf3cc8eb1ee247e27b81c/docs/uat/20261020-pr30-obs01-fix-uat/evidence/browser.jsonl) · [服务器](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/blob/e289c79346d9417ae9acf3cc8eb1ee247e27b81c/docs/uat/20261020-pr30-obs01-fix-uat/evidence/server.log) · [文件校验](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/blob/e289c79346d9417ae9acf3cc8eb1ee247e27b81c/docs/uat/20261020-pr30-obs01-fix-uat/evidence/obs-file-validation.json) · [业务导出校验](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/blob/e289c79346d9417ae9acf3cc8eb1ee247e27b81c/docs/uat/20261020-pr30-obs01-fix-uat/evidence/business-file-validation.json) · [SHA256](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/blob/e289c79346d9417ae9acf3cc8eb1ee247e27b81c/docs/uat/20261020-pr30-obs01-fix-uat/SHA256SUMS.txt)

Overall acceptance remains **FAIL** for one P3 conditional visibility defect: with Project operations collapsed and the header scrolled away, a correctly blocked backup has no currently visible reason. Open-drawer controls do show left-side feedback.29 directed clicks yielded26 files and3 safe blocks; one earlier baseline backup makes27 validated S4 ZIPs. Original raw failures and N02's missed timing are preserved; true in-flight safety was rechecked in B01. Native Windows/desktop Excel/production fault load/full reference pixel parity/exhaustive independent matrix are NOT TESTED. Finite samples do not prove every race absent.
